summary: Independent audit passed: pure offline deterministic SOL address cleaning CLI verified fail-closed on hash mismatch, label fidelity preserved without inference, strict Solana Base58 normalization enforced, zero external data in repository/git, console output scrubbed of raw addresses and label text, zero network access.

pure_offline_execution.evidence: No network calls or HTTP clients used; all operations perform local file IO.

label_fidelity.evidence: Labels are trimmed, empty values removed, duplicates within same wallet removed, first order preserved. No inference of wallet tier, profitability or cluster.

fail_closed_hash_verification.evidence: Option expectedHashes validates input files SHA256; throws input_manifest_mismatch error code on mismatch.

repository_cleanliness.evidence: Synthetic fixtures used exclusively in unit/integration tests; zero user address/label data committed to Git.

console_privacy.evidence: CLI stdout/stderr logs only counts, SHA256 hashes, status, and error codes; no raw full address or label text printed.
